resources.string: Overrides the default resolver for this profile. MagicDNS and more-specific routes stay under Tailscale control. No generic-provider fallback is used. Generic resolver bootstrap may send only the provider hostname in plaintext to the underlying network DNS, outside an exit node.

Automatically follows the saved Android provider while the VPN is running, without reopening this screen or reconnecting. Control D hostnames are currently supported. Missing or unsupported providers block default DNS instead of falling back. Turn this option off for manual HTTPS configuration.
Press keyboard Done to save a valid HTTPS endpoint. The local resolver must be enabled separately.
Strict Android Private DNS is active and may bypass or conflict with VPN DNS. TailD does not change that system setting.
